carry_person.description: Pick up a trapped person. At least 2 agents must carry simultaneously to succeed.

person_id.description: ID of the person to carry (e.g., LostTimmy)

clear_inventory.description: Clear your entire inventory (drop all carried items).

coordinator/finish_task.description: Call this when the overall SAR mission is complete. Signals that all fires are extinguished and all persons are rescued.

drop_off_person.description: Drop a carried person at a safe deposit location.

person_id.description: ID of the person being carried

deposit_id.description: ID of the deposit to drop them at

explore.description: Explore unknown surrounding area. Multiple steps at once.

get_agent_state.description: Query your current position, inventory, and nearby objects. Use this to check where you are and what you're carrying. Does NOT consume a step — safe to call anytime.

get_supply.description: Collect firefighting supplies from a reservoir or deposit.

source_id.description: ID of the reservoir or deposit to get supply from

supply_type.description: Type of supply — Water or Sand

move.description: Move one step in a cardinal direction.

direction.description: Direction to move — Up, Down, Left, Right, Center

navigate_to.description: Navigate to an object by its ID. Use this to move toward any visible object.

target_id.description: ID of the target object (e.g., WaterSource_1, GreatFire_Region_1)

no_op.description: Do nothing this step. Use when waiting for other agents or when your task is complete.

query_control_journal.description: Query the control transition journal of the current scope, optionally narrowed by dispatch id. Read-only journal entries.

dispatch_id.description: Optional dispatch id; when omitted all journal entries of the scope are returned.

query_projection.description: Query the committed memory projection of the current scope (spatial or embodied), optionally narrowed to one entity. Read-only view of committed evidence; exposes no source-state selection parameters.

entity_id.description: Optional entity id; when omitted the full projection of the domain is returned.

query_sar_state.description: Get the current state of the Search & Rescue environment. Returns all fires (position, intensity, type), persons (position, status), reservoirs (position, resource_type), deposits, and agent states (position, inventory). Use this to understand the current situation before assigning subtasks.

query_semantic_map.description: Query the coordinator-maintained semantic map. Does not read environment oracle state.

query_shared_memory.description: Query coordinator semantic map shared memory. Does not consume SAR env steps.

query_supervision.description: Query the committed supervision event count of the current scope. Read-only counter of supervision.* canonical events.

query_team_status.description: Query team-level worker status and recent observation summaries. Does not read environment oracle state.

query_temporal_flow.description: Query the committed temporal event flow of the current scope in sequence order, optionally after a sequence cursor. Read-only view; diagnostic audit events are excluded from this view.

after_sequence.description: Optional cursor; only events with sequence strictly greater than this value are returned.

report_observation.description: Non-blocking report of local SAR observations to the coordinator semantic map.

store_supply.description: Store your current supplies at a deposit.

deposit_id.description: ID of the deposit to store supplies at

use_supply.description: Use firefighting supply on a fire to extinguish it.

fire_id.description: ID of the fire to extinguish (use _Region suffix, e.g., GreatFire_Region_1)

supply_type.description: Type of supply to use — Water or Sand

worker/finish_task.description: Call this when your assigned subtask is complete. Sends a completion signal to the coordinator with the result.

summary.description: What you did and the outcome

task_description.description: Description of the task you completed
